Realp descent fuel check → Back to Altdorf drops about 1080 m over 41 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

Gotthard Tremola cobbles → Airolo fuel and water drops about 931 m over 6 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2429 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Klausen Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 71 km. 986 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

furka-grimsel-susten-big-three-dawn-and-.story: A one-way ride of 452 km, Altdorf to Andermatt - roughly 9 h 20 in the saddle. The climbs: Sustenpass west, Grimselpass reservoirs, Furkapass glacier road and Gotthard Tremola cobbles. It tops out at 2,478 m. Susten Pass, Grimsel Pass, Furka Pass and Gotthard Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.
